text: The program has secured US$29.91 million in CIF-approved funding, with an expected co-financing of US$6.66 million. It has facilitated climate-resilient infrastructure projects, such as the climate-proofing of the Alotau Provincial Wharf, and supported capacity building for climate resilience and post-harvest technologies for smallholder coffee farmers.

metadata.solution_name: Climate Investment Funds – Pilot Program for Climate Resilience (PPCR) in Papua New Guinea
